_comment: Which addresses in this repository are NOT documents to archive.
Every rule carries a reason, and every exclusion is printed by
'refs.py harvest --report', so a wrong rule is visible instead of silent.
An unmatched URL is KEPT: this classifier fails towards review.

rules.reason: a GitHub USER or ORGANISATION profile page, not a document. It lists repositories rather than teaching anything, and it changes every time its owner pushes
XML namespace identifier inside a payload template, not a document
Microsoft XML namespace identifier used by a payload, not a document. Scoped to namespace hosts on purpose: an earlier, wider rule silently swallowed a devblogs.microsoft.com research article.
SOAP namespace identifier written into payload documents
local test endpoint used by the test suite or an example
private-network address in an example or a payload
placeholder host in help text or an example command
out-of-band callback endpoint used by the test harness
package feed or artifact download, not research material
licence text referenced by a licence header
single-label placeholder host (AttackerServer, YOUR-SHAREPOINT-BASE, attacker) in help text, an example, or a test fixture
RFC 2606/6761 reserved name used by a test fixture or an example
URL template carrying a variable, not a fixed address
this project's own repository, release feed, or site

decorative or live-generated asset (a README badge, an avatar). The archive keeps material that ADDS to the document - a diagram, a chart, an image of code - not chrome, and a badge is regenerated on every release so any snapshot of it is stale on arrival
the maintainer's own short domain, used as an example fetch target in a gadget option's help text. It is an address a payload retrieves, not a document

reference source archive download. Measured 2026-08-03: it now redirects to github.com/microsoft/referencesource, which carries .NET Framework 4.6.2 rather than the 4.8 material the file cites, so downloading it would preserve the wrong thing
JSON schema identifier used by a config file
